[[File:Cure Plant icon (mobile).png|left]]
'''Cure Plant''' is a [[Lunar spell]] that cures a diseased [[Farming]] patch. Unlike [[Resurrect Crops]], it cannot revive a patch that has already died from disease. 

Its use is most cost effective when cast while wielding a [[Staff of earth]], or equivalent other staff. Players may find the cost of the runes required to cast Cure Plant makes its use undesireable, because a [[plant cure]] potion can be purchased from the nearby [[Group_of_Advanced_Gardeners|gardener]] for only 25 [[coins]] and performs the same function.

Casting Cure Plant awards the player with 91.5 [[Farming]] experience and 60 [[Magic]] experience. As with all Lunar spells, the quest [[Lunar Diplomacy]] must be completed to cast this spell.

==Trivia==
* Cure Plant has multiple unique messages when attempting to use it on something that is not a diseased plant:
** Casting the spell on a growing, non-diseased plant gives the message {{mes|It's growing just fine.}}
** Casting the spell on a patch that is fully grown gives the message {{mes|That's not diseased.}}
** Casting the spell on a compost bin gives the message {{mes|Bins don't often get diseased.}}
** Casting the spell on a patch with weeds gives the message {{mes|The weeds are healthy enough already.}}
** Casting the spell on an empty patch gives the message {{mes|There's nothing there to cure.}}
** Casting the spell on a dead patch gives the message {{mes|It says 'Cure' not 'Resurrect'. Although death may arise from disease, it is not in itself a disease and hence cannot be cured. So there.}}
** Casting the spell on any other object causes the player to state "''Umm... this spell won't cure that!''"
